owner_target: Repair every accepted in-scope White Ace BLOCKER/HIGH defect and prove one immutable repository candidate without deploying it.
release_gate: All local repair, independent proof, rollback, exact-SHA CI, and authorised environment vetoes are PROVEN on one clean candidate; production release remains a separate owner action.
protected_actions: change certificate, object-storage, or evidence behavior
change secret files, credentials, or provider configuration
change checksum-managed Engineering OS workflow files

phases.name: authority-baseline
phases.exit_gate: Dirty work, immutable baseline, owner target, and prohibited actions are reconciled.

phases.name: adjudication-and-approval
phases.exit_gate: Every accepted finding is reproduced and each protected repair has explicit owner authority.

phases.name: sequential-repair-waves
phases.exit_gate: Lead-owned repair nodes are integrated and marked FIXED without self-certification.

phases.name: independent-proof
phases.exit_gate: Behavioral, held-out, and mutation proofs independently close every repaired finding.

phases.name: integrated-candidate
phases.exit_gate: Rollback and the full non-vacuous candidate gate pass on one clean SHA.

phases.name: external-evidence
phases.exit_gate: Supply-chain, GitHub, staging, provider, restore, and physical-device evidence is observed on the exact candidate.

phases.name: release-boundary
phases.exit_gate: The owner receives the exact candidate and independently decides whether to release.
